notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 9a writes Yochanan ben Toreta, whereas the supplied notice has bar Toreta.

The actual Davidson Chullin 127a paragraph names Rav Huna bar Toreta, and Yoma 9a explicitly names Rabbi Yochanan ben Toreta. The supplied second bar form and current note are retained. This does not identify the fathers or import the surrounding narrative or teachings.
